# Changzhou Malong Chemicals Co., Ltd.

> Changzhou Malong Chemicals Co., Ltd. supplies CAS-listed chemical intermediates for pharmaceutical, agrochemical and fine chemical synthesis. Product pages are published in English, Spanish and Russian with CAS search.

Last updated: 2026-08-18

- Contact: https://www.malongchemicals.com/contact/
